CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   C. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

4. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   B. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

5. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   C. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

13. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

14. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   B. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.

15. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
